en: I do what is mine to do; the rest doesn't disturb me.
zh: 我做我该做的事；其余的事不会扰乱我。
where: Meditations 6.22 (Hays translation, as given on Wikiquote)

en: No matter what anyone says or does, my task is to be good.
zh: 不论别人说什么、做什么，我的任务就是做个好人。
where: Meditations 7.15 (Hays translation, as given on Wikiquote)

en: Choose not to be harmed—and you won't feel harmed. Don't feel harmed—and you haven't been.
zh: 选择不受伤害，你就不会感到受伤；不觉得受伤，你就没有受伤。
where: Meditations 4.7 (Hays translation, as given on Wikiquote)

en: Nothing happens to anyone that he can't endure.
zh: 落在任何人身上的事，没有一件是他承受不了的。
where: Meditations 5.18 (Hays translation, as given on Wikiquote)

en: But true good fortune is what you make for yourself. Good fortune: good character, good intentions, and good actions.
zh: 真正的好运是你自己创造的。好运就是：好的品格、好的意图和好的行动。
where: Meditations 5.37 (Hays translation, as given on Wikiquote)

en: Know the joy of life by piling good deed on good deed until no rift or cranny appears between them.
zh: 要懂得生活的快乐：把一件善行叠在另一件善行上，直到它们之间不留一丝缝隙。
where: Meditations 12.29 (no translator named on Wikiquote)

en: In your actions, don't procrastinate.
zh: 行动上，不要拖延。
where: Meditations 8.51 (as cited on Wikiquote via Holiday; no translator named)

en: Get straight to doing what nature requires of you
zh: 立刻去做本性要求你做的事。
where: Meditations 8.5 (as cited on Wikiquote via Holiday; no translator named)

en: In the morning, when thou art sluggish at rousing thee, let this thought be present; “I am rising to a man's work.”
zh: 早晨懒得起身时，让这个念头出现：“我起来，是去做一个人该做的工作。”
where: Meditations 5.1 (as quoted in Bartlett's Familiar Quotations, per Wikiquote)

en: Find time still to be learning somewhat good, and give up being desultory.
zh: 仍要抽出时间学些有益的东西，不要再散漫随意。
where: Meditations 2.7 (as quoted in Bartlett's Familiar Quotations, per Wikiquote)

en: Shame on the soul, to falter on the road of life while the body still perseveres.
zh: 身体还在坚持，灵魂却在人生的路上动摇，那才是可耻的。
where: Meditations 6.29 (trans. Maxwell Staniforth, per Wikiquote)

en: While thou livest, while it is in thy power, be good.
zh: 趁你还活着，趁你还有这个能力，就去行善。
where: Meditations 4.17 (trans. George Long, per Wikiquote)

en: The nearer a man comes to a calm mind, the closer he is to strength.
zh: 一个人越接近内心的平静，就越接近力量。
where: Meditations 11.18 (as cited on Wikiquote via Holiday; no translator named)

en: Some things are in our control and others not.
zh: 有些事在我们的掌控之中，有些则不在。
where: Enchiridion 1.1 (trans. Elizabeth Carter, 1759, as given on Wikiquote)

en: With every accident, ask yourself what abilities you have for making a proper use of it.
zh: 每遇到一件意外，就问问自己：我有什么能力可以好好利用它。
where: Enchiridion 10 (trans. Elizabeth Carter, 1759, as given on Wikiquote)

en: If you are in pain, you will find fortitude.
zh: 如果你正在承受痛苦，你会找到坚韧。
where: Enchiridion 10 (trans. Elizabeth Carter, 1759, as given on Wikiquote)

en: Men are disturbed, not by things, but by the principles and notions which they form concerning things.
zh: 困扰人们的不是事情本身，而是他们对事情所持的看法和观念。
where: Enchiridion 5 (trans. Elizabeth Carter, 1759, as given on Wikiquote)

en: Everything has two handles, the one by which it may be carried, the other by which it cannot.
zh: 每件事都有两个把手：一个可以拿起来，另一个拿不起来。
where: Enchiridion 43 (trans. Elizabeth Carter, 1759, as given on Wikiquote)

en: It is difficulties that show what men are.
zh: 困难才显出人的本色。
where: Discourses I.24.1 (no translator named on Wikiquote)

en: No thing great is created suddenly, any more than a bunch of grapes or a fig.
zh: 没有伟大的事物是突然诞生的，就像一串葡萄或一颗无花果一样。
where: Discourses I.15.7 (no translator named on Wikiquote)

en: If you would be a good reader, read; if a writer, write.
zh: 想做好的读者，就去读；想做作家，就去写。
where: Discourses II.18.1 (no translator named on Wikiquote)

en: Practice yourself, for heaven's sake, in little things; and thence proceed to greater.
zh: 看在老天的份上，先在小事上练习自己，再逐步做更大的事。
where: Discourses I.18.18 (no translator named on Wikiquote)

en: It was for this that I've been training myself, it was for this that I was practising.
zh: 我一直训练自己，一直练习，为的就是这一刻。
where: Discourses III.10.7 (no translator named on Wikiquote)

en: Any one thing in the creation is sufficient to demonstrate a Providence to an humble and grateful mind.
zh: 对谦逊而感恩的心来说，造物中的任何一样东西都足以显明天意。
where: Discourses I.16.7 (no translator named on Wikiquote)

en: Were I a nightingale, I would act the part of a nightingale; were I a swan, the part of a swan.
zh: 我若是夜莺，就做夜莺该做的事；若是天鹅，就做天鹅该做的事。
where: Discourses I.16.20 (no translator named on Wikiquote)

en: Lay hold of today's task, and you will not need to depend so much upon tomorrow's.
zh: 抓住今天的任务，你就不必那么依赖明天。
where: Moral Letters to Lucilius, Letter I, trans. Richard Mott Gummere (1925), as given on Wikiquote

en: Therefore, my dear Lucilius, begin at once to live, and count each separate day as a separate life.
zh: 所以，亲爱的卢基里乌斯，立刻开始生活吧，把每一天都当作一次独立的人生。
where: Moral Letters to Lucilius, Letter CI, trans. Richard Mott Gummere (1925), as given on Wikiquote

en: As long as you live, keep learning how to live.
zh: 只要活着，就继续学习如何生活。
where: Moral Letters to Lucilius, Letter LXXVI, trans. Richard Mott Gummere (1925), as given on Wikiquote

en: It is a rough road that leads to the heights of greatness.
zh: 通往伟大之巅的路是崎岖的。
where: Moral Letters to Lucilius, Letter LXXXIV, trans. Richard Mott Gummere (1925), as given on Wikiquote

en: Prove your words by your deeds.
zh: 用行动证明你的话。
where: Moral Letters to Lucilius, Letter XX, trans. Richard Mott Gummere (1925), as given on Wikiquote

en: I forbid you to be cast down or depressed. It is not enough if you do not shrink from work; ask for it.
zh: 我不许你沮丧消沉。不躲避工作还不够，要主动去要工作。
where: Moral Letters to Lucilius, Letter XXXI, trans. Richard Mott Gummere (1925), as given on Wikiquote

en: If you would not have a man flinch when the crisis comes, train him before it comes.
zh: 想让一个人在危机来临时不退缩，就在危机来临之前训练他。
where: Moral Letters to Lucilius, Letter XVIII, trans. Richard Mott Gummere (1925), as given on Wikiquote

en: Our lack of confidence is not the result of difficulty. The difficulty comes from our lack of confidence.
zh: 我们缺乏信心，不是因为事情困难；事情之所以困难，是因为我们缺乏信心。
where: Moral Letters to Lucilius, Letter CIV, trans. Richard Mott Gummere (1925), as given on Wikiquote

en: Clothe yourself with a hero's courage, and withdraw for a little space from the opinions of the common man.
zh: 披上英雄的勇气，暂时离开普通人的意见。
where: Moral Letters to Lucilius, Letter LXVII, trans. Richard Mott Gummere (1925), as given on Wikiquote

en: A great pilot can sail even when his canvas is rent.
zh: 优秀的舵手，即使船帆破了也能前行。
where: Moral Letters to Lucilius, Letter XXX, trans. Richard Mott Gummere (1925), as given on Wikiquote

en: Make me braver, make me calmer, make me the equal of Fortune, make me her superior.
zh: 让我更勇敢，让我更平静，让我与命运比肩，甚至胜过她。
where: Moral Letters to Lucilius, Letter CXVI (no translator named on Wikiquote)

en: Fire tries gold, misfortune tries brave men.
zh: 火炼真金，厄运炼勇者。
where: De Providentia 5.9, trans. Aubrey Stewart, as given on Wikiquote

en: Valor withers without adversity.
zh: 没有逆境，勇气就会枯萎。
where: De Providentia 2.4, trans. Aubrey Stewart, as given on Wikiquote

en: He who receives a benefit with gratitude, repays the first installment of it.
zh: 怀着感激接受恩惠的人，已经还了第一期的债。
where: De Beneficiis 2.22, trans. Aubrey Stewart, as given on Wikiquote

en: Let us greedily enjoy our friends, because we do not know how long this privilege will be ours.
zh: 让我们尽情享受朋友相伴的时光，因为我们不知道这份特权还能持续多久。
where: Moral Letters to Lucilius, Letter LXIII, trans. Richard Mott Gummere (1925), as given on Wikiquote

en: We have water, we have porridge; let us compete in happiness with Jupiter himself.
zh: 我们有水，有粥；让我们同朱庇特比一比谁更幸福。
where: Moral Letters to Lucilius, Letter CX (no translator named on Wikiquote)

en: What it lies in our power to do, it lies in our power not to do.
zh: 凡是我们有能力去做的，我们也有能力不去做。
where: Nicomachean Ethics, Book III, ch. 5 (no translator named on Wikiquote)

en: For the things we have to learn before we can do, we learn by doing.
zh: 我们必须先学才能做的事，是在做的过程中学会的。
where: Nicomachean Ethics, Book II, 1103a (cited in Oxford Dictionary of Scientific Quotations, 2005; no translator named)

en: The superior man is modest in his speech, but exceeds in his actions.
zh: 君子言之谨慎，而行动上超过所言。
where: Analects, Book IV (trans. James Legge, as given on Wikiquote)

en: When you meet someone better than yourself, turn your thoughts to becoming his equal.
zh: 见到比自己强的人，就想着向他看齐。
where: Analects, Book IV (trans. D. C. Lau, 1979, as given on Wikiquote)

en: I will select their good qualities and follow them, their bad qualities and avoid them.
zh: 我要选取他们的优点去学习，对他们的缺点引以为戒。
where: Analects 7.21 (trans. James Legge, as given on Wikiquote)

en: I am not concerned that I have no place; I am concerned how I may fit myself for one.
zh: 我不担心没有职位，我担心的是如何让自己配得上一个职位。
where: Analects 4.14, as quoted in Will Durant, Our Oriental Heritage (per Wikiquote)

en: Before a man can do things there must be things he will not do.
zh: 一个人要有所作为，先要有所不为。
where: Book 4B, 8, as translated by John T. McNeill in A History of the Cure of Souls (1951), p. 59 (per Wikiquote)

en: The virtues are not poured into us, they are natural. Seek, and you will find them: neglect, and you will lose them.
zh: 美德不是灌输给我们的，它们是天然的。去寻求，你就会找到；忽视，就会失去。
where: "Uses and Sanctions" no. 22, in Pebbles, Pearls and Gems of the Orient, ed. Charles D. B. Mills (1882)

en: To attain knowledge, add things every day. To attain wisdom, remove things every day.
zh: 求知，每天增加一点；求智慧，每天减少一点。
where: Tao Te Ching, ch. 48 (no translator named on Wikiquote)

en: Forget the years, forget distinctions. Leap into the boundless and make it your home!
zh: 忘掉岁月，忘掉分别。跃入无边无际，把它当作你的家！
where: Chapter 2, trans. Burton Watson (1968), as given on Wikiquote

en: Hope is like a road in the country; there was never a road, but when many people walk on it, the road comes into existence.
zh: 希望就像乡间的路：原本没有路，走的人多了，路就有了。
where: The Wisdom of China and India, ed. and trans. Lin Yutang (Random House, 1942), "The Epigrams of Lusin", p. 8

en: The time is always right to do what's right.
zh: 做正确的事，任何时候都是对的时机。
where: "The Future of Integration", Oberlin College address (1964)

en: Darkness cannot drive out darkness: only light can do that. Hate cannot drive out hate: only love can do that.
zh: 黑暗驱不走黑暗，只有光明可以；仇恨驱不走仇恨，只有爱可以。
where: Where Do We Go from Here: Chaos or Community? (1967)

en: Love is the only force capable of transforming an enemy into a friend.
zh: 唯有爱，能把敌人变成朋友。
where: "Loving Your Enemies", Christmas 1957 sermon

en: Non-cooperation with evil is as much a moral obligation as is cooperation with good.
zh: 不与恶合作，和与善合作一样，是一种道德义务。
where: Stride Toward Freedom (1958)

en: Keep moving. Let nothing slow you up. Move on with dignity and honor and respectability.
zh: 继续前进。别让任何事拖慢你。带着尊严、荣誉和体面向前走。
where: "Give Us the Ballot" (1957)

en: Love is the most durable power in the world.
zh: 爱是世界上最持久的力量。
where: "Loving Your Enemies", Christmas 1957 sermon

en: Sapere Aude! Have the courage to use your own intelligence!
zh: 敢于认识！要有勇气运用你自己的理智！
where: "What is Enlightenment?" (1784), as given on Wikiquote (no translator named)

en: Morality is not properly the doctrine of how we may make ourselves happy, but how we may make ourselves worthy of happiness.
zh: 道德严格说来不是教我们如何使自己幸福，而是教我们如何使自己配得上幸福。
where: Critique of Practical Reason (1788), as given on Wikiquote (no translator named)

en: What man actually needs is not a tensionless state but rather the striving and struggling for some goal worthy of him.
zh: 人真正需要的不是毫无张力的状态，而是为一个值得的目标去奋斗、去拼搏。
where: Man's Search for Meaning (1946; Beacon Press edition 1959)

en: We can only learn to love by loving.
zh: 我们只能通过去爱来学会爱。
where: The Bell (1958)

en: To ask how things are going and whether they can be improved is a constant and inescapable part of the pursuit of justice.
zh: 询问事情进展如何、能否改进，是追求正义中恒常而不可回避的一部分。
where: The Idea of Justice (2009), ch. 3

en: Strength does not come from physical capacity. It comes from an indomitable will.
zh: 力量不来自体力，而来自不屈的意志。
where: Young India, 11 August 1920, "The Doctrine of the Sword"

en: Develop enough courage so that you can stand up for yourself and then stand up for somebody else.
zh: 培养足够的勇气，先为自己站出来，再为别人站出来。
where: Rainbow in the Cloud: The Wisdom and Spirit of Maya Angelou (2014), p. 68

en: Life is going to give you just what you put in it. Put your whole heart in everything you do, and pray, then you can wait.
zh: 生活会给你你投入的东西。把全部的心放进你做的每件事里，祈祷，然后耐心等待。
where: I Know Why the Caged Bird Sings (1969)

en: One never notices what has been done; one can only see what remains to be done.
zh: 人从来注意不到已经做完的事，只看得见还需要做的事。
where: Letter to her brother (1894)

en: I was taught that the way of progress was neither swift nor easy.
zh: 我从小就被教导：进步之路既不快，也不容易。
where: as quoted in Atul Apte, Java Connector Architecture (2002), p. 69, per Wikiquote

en: You gain strength, courage, and confidence by every experience in which you really stop to look fear in the face.
zh: 每一次你真正直面恐惧的经历，都会给你力量、勇气和信心。
where: You Learn by Living (1960), pp. 29-30

en: You must do the thing you think you cannot do.
zh: 你必须去做那件你以为自己做不到的事。
where: You Learn by Living (1960), pp. 29-30

en: I learned that courage was not the absence of fear, but the triumph over it.
zh: 我懂得了：勇气不是没有恐惧，而是战胜恐惧。
where: Long Walk to Freedom (1995)

en: Difficulties break some men but make others.
zh: 困难击垮一些人，却成就另一些人。
where: Letter to Winnie Mandela, 1 February 1975

en: But I have discovered the secret that after climbing a great hill, one only finds that there are many more hills to climb.
zh: 但我发现了一个秘密：爬过一座大山之后，你会发现还有更多的山要爬。
where: Long Walk to Freedom (1995)

en: I've failed over and over and over again in my life. And that is why I succeed.
zh: 我一生中一次又一次地失败。这正是我成功的原因。
where: Robert Goldman and Stephen Papson, Nike Culture (1998), p. 49

en: Our greatest weakness lies in giving up. The most certain way to succeed is always to try just one more time.
zh: 我们最大的弱点是放弃。最稳妥的成功之道，就是再试一次。
where: Edison & Ford Quote Book (2003)

en: Everything comes to him who hustles while he waits.
zh: 凡事都会降临到那个边等边拼搏的人身上。
where: Francis Arthur Jones, Thomas Alva Edison: Sixty Years of an Inventor's Life (1908), p. 14

en: The value of a college education is not the learning of many facts but the training of the mind to think.
zh: 大学教育的价值不在于学到许多事实，而在于训练头脑去思考。
where: New York Times, 18 May 1921

en: Imagination is more important than knowledge. Knowledge is limited. Imagination encircles the world.
zh: 想象力比知识更重要。知识是有限的，想象力环绕整个世界。
where: Interview with George Sylvester Viereck (1929)

en: Never be afraid of the moments—thus sings the voice of the everlasting.
zh: 不要害怕那些瞬间——永恒之声这样歌唱。
where: Stray Birds (1916)

en: Life is given to us, we earn it by giving it.
zh: 生命是被赐予我们的，我们通过奉献它来赢得它。
where: Stray Birds (1916)

en: Until you dig a hole, you plant a tree, you water it and make it survive, you haven't done a thing. You are just talking.
zh: 除非你挖坑、种树、浇水并让它活下来，否则你什么也没做，只是在说话。
where: Speech at the Goldman Awards, San Francisco, 24 April 2006

en: What people see as fearlessness is really persistence.
zh: 人们看作无畏的东西，其实是坚持。
where: Unbowed (2006), as cited on Wikiquote

en: You don't need a diploma to plant a tree.
zh: 种一棵树，不需要文凭。
where: Unbowed (2006), as cited on Wikiquote

en: If we want to solve a problem that we have never solved before, we must leave the door to the unknown ajar.
zh: 如果我们想解决一个从未解决过的问题，就必须让通往未知的门留一条缝。
where: The Value of Science (1955)

en: What I cannot create, I do not understand.
zh: 我不能创造的东西，我就不理解。
where: Blackboard note at the time of his death (1988)

en: I set out with high hope, and a fixed purpose, at whatever cost of trouble, to learn how to read.
zh: 我怀着高度的希望和坚定的决心出发，不惜任何麻烦，一定要学会读书。
where: Narrative of the Life of Frederick Douglass, An American Slave (1845)

en: You have seen how a man was made a slave; you shall see how a slave was made a man.
zh: 你们已经看到一个人如何被变成奴隶；你们将看到一个奴隶如何成为一个人。
where: Narrative of the Life of Frederick Douglass, An American Slave (1845)

en: A life is not important except in the impact it has on other lives.
zh: 一个人的生命，重要的只在于它对其他生命产生的影响。
where: I Never Had It Made (1972)

en: Passion is never enough; neither is skill. But try.
zh: 仅有热情不够，仅有技艺也不够。但要去尝试。
where: Nobel Prize Lecture (1993)

en: You free. Nothing and nobody is obliged to save you but you.
zh: 你是自由的。除了你自己，没有任何人、任何事有义务拯救你。
where: Home (2012)

en: If you find a book you really want to read but it hasn't been written yet, then you must write it.
zh: 如果你想读一本书，却发现它还没人写，那你就必须自己去写。
where: Talk at the Ohio Arts Council (1981)

en: Determine that the thing can and shall be done, and then we shall find the way.
zh: 先下定决心：这件事能做，也必须做，然后我们就会找到办法。
where: Speech in the House of Representatives, 20 June 1848

en: Always bear in mind that your own resolution to succeed, is more important than any other one thing.
zh: 永远记住，你自己成功的决心，比其他任何一件事都重要。
where: Letter to Isham Reavis, 5 November 1855

en: The way for a young man to rise, is to improve himself every way he can, never suspecting that any body wishes to hinder him.
zh: 年轻人上进的办法，是尽一切可能提高自己，而且不要猜疑有人想阻碍他。
where: Letter to William H. Herndon, 10 July 1848

en: Leave nothing for to-morrow which can be done to-day. Never let your correspondence fall behind.
zh: 今天能做的事不要留给明天。不要让你的通信积压。
where: Fragment, Notes for a Law Lecture, 1 July 1850

en: I don't measure America by its achievement but by its potential.
zh: 我衡量美国，不看它的成就，而看它的潜力。
where: Unbought and Unbossed (1970), p. 175

en: I told them that no one has a right to call himself a leader unless he dares to lead.
zh: 我告诉他们：除非敢于带头，否则没有人有资格自称领导者。
where: Unbought and Unbossed (1970)

en: It is curious that physical courage should be so common in the world, and moral courage so rare.
zh: 奇怪的是，世上身体上的勇气这么常见，道德上的勇气却这么罕见。
where: Mark Twain in Eruption, ed. Bernard DeVoto (1940)

en: All you need in this life is ignorance and confidence, and then Success is sure.
zh: 在这一生里你只需要无知和自信，成功就稳了。
where: Mark Twain's Notebook (1887)

en: It is not enough to be industrious; so are the ants. What are you industrious about?
zh: 光勤奋是不够的，蚂蚁也勤奋。你的勤奋是为了什么？
where: Letter to Harrison Blake, 16 November 1857

en: How vain it is to sit down to write when you have not stood up to live.
zh: 你还没有站起来生活，就坐下来写作，那是多么徒劳。
where: Journals, 19 August 1851

en: It is a great art to saunter.
zh: 懂得漫步是一门了不起的艺术。
where: Journals, 26 April 1841

en: Only that day dawns to which we are awake. There is more day to dawn.
zh: 只有我们醒着的那一天才算破晓。还有更多的天要破晓。
where: Walden (1854)

en: You must get your living by loving.
zh: 你必须靠热爱来谋生。
where: Life Without Principle (1863)

en: Nature is full of genius, full of the divinity; so that not a snowflake escapes its fashioning hand.
zh: 自然充满天才，充满神性，连一片雪花也逃不过它塑造的手。
where: Journals, 5 January 1856

en: And the point is, to live everything. Live the questions now.
zh: 要点是，去经历一切。现在就活在这些问题里。
where: Letters to a Young Poet, Letter Four (1903)

en: Great artists make the roads; good teachers and good companions can point them out.
zh: 伟大的艺术家开辟道路；好老师和好同伴可以指出这些路。
where: The Language of the Night (1979)

en: We read books to find out who we are.
zh: 我们读书，是为了弄清楚自己是谁。
where: "Prophets and Mirrors: Science Fiction as a Way of Seeing" (1970)

en: Fight for the things that you care about, but do it in a way that will lead others to join you.
zh: 为你在乎的事情而战，但要用能让别人加入你的方式。
where: Radcliffe Medal acceptance statement (2015)

en: Generally change in our society is incremental. Real change, enduring change, happens one step at a time.
zh: 社会的变化通常是渐进的。真正的、持久的变化，是一步一步发生的。
where: Interview with ThinkProgress (2015)

en: Women belong in all places where decisions are being made. It shouldn't be that women are the exception.
zh: 凡是做决定的地方都应该有女性。女性不该是例外。

en: One child, one teacher, one book and one pen can change the world.
zh: 一个孩子、一位老师、一本书、一支笔，就能改变世界。
where: Speech to the UN General Assembly, June 2013

en: One can never consent to creep when one feels an impulse to soar.
zh: 当你心里有飞翔的冲动时，就绝不会甘心爬行。
where: Address to the American Association to Promote the Teaching of Speech to the Deaf (1896)

en: Avoiding danger is no safer in the long run than outright exposure. The fearful are caught as often as the bold.
zh: 长远来看，躲避危险并不比直接面对更安全。胆怯的人和大胆的人一样常常被抓住。
where: Let Us Have Faith (1940)

en: Life is either a daring adventure, or nothing.
zh: 生活要么是一场勇敢的冒险，要么什么都不是。
where: The Open Door (1957)

en: Every individual matters. Every individual has a role to play. Every individual makes a difference.
zh: 每个人都重要，每个人都有自己的角色，每个人都能带来改变。
where: With Love (1999)

en: Only if we understand can we care. Only if we care will we help. Only if we help shall they be saved.
zh: 只有理解，我们才会关心；只有关心，我们才会出手；只有出手，它们才能得救。
where: Animal Magnetism (1998)

en: Wonder and humility are wholesome emotions, and they do not exist side by side with a lust for destruction.
zh: 好奇与谦逊是健康的情感，它们不会与毁灭的欲望并存。
where: Speech accepting the John Burroughs Medal (1952)

en: You have to dream before your dreams can come true.
zh: 你必须先有梦想，梦想才能成真。
where: Wings of Fire: An Autobiography (1999), p. 112

en: Man needs his difficulties because they are necessary to enjoy success.
zh: 人需要困难，因为只有经历困难才能享受成功。
where: Wings of Fire: An Autobiography (1999), p. 90

en: Dream is not that which you see while sleeping; it is something that does not let you sleep.
zh: 梦想不是你睡觉时看到的东西，而是让你无法入睡的东西。
where: Wings of Fire: An Autobiography (1999)

en: Come, seek, for search is the foundation of fortune: Every success depends upon focusing the heart.
zh: 来，去寻找吧，探求是好运的基础：每一次成功都取决于专注的心。
where: Masnavi III, 2302-5 (trans. Kabir Helminski, 1996)

en: The lion who breaks the enemy's ranks is a minor hero compared to the lion who overcomes himself.
zh: 冲破敌阵的狮子，比起战胜自己的狮子，只能算小英雄。
where: Masnavi I, 1389 (no translator named on Wikiquote)

en: So vie with one another in good works.
zh: 你们当竞相行善。
where: Sura 2:148 (trans. Pickthall, as given on Wikiquote)

en: O Believers! Seek comfort in patience and prayer. God is certainly with those who are patient
zh: 信士们啊！你们当借坚忍和礼拜求得慰藉。真主确与坚忍者同在。
where: Sura 2:153 (trans. Muhammad Ali, as given on Wikiquote)

en: They did not lose heart, despite all that they had to suffer in God's path.
zh: 尽管在主道上受尽苦难，他们并没有灰心。
where: Sura 3:146 (trans. Wahiduddin Khan, as given on Wikiquote)

en: You are your own forerunner, and the towers you have builded are but the foundation of your giant-self.
zh: 你是你自己的先行者，你所建的塔，不过是你那巨大自我的地基。
where: The Forerunner (1920)
